terms_description: Terms for using Atlas Nusantara, an informational regional atlas of Indonesia.
terms_use_text: Atlas Nusantara is an informational tool. It is not an emergency alert service and must not be the only basis for safety decisions. In an emergency, follow official advisories from BMKG, BNPB and local authorities.
terms_data_text: The atlas brings together information about Indonesia from many sources, including observations and warnings from providers such as BMKG, BNPB, InaRISK and WorldPop, and boundaries and place data from attributed datasets. Records are dated and may be delayed, incomplete or revised. Each owner's attribution and licence terms apply when you reuse the data.
terms_boundaries_text: Region codes follow Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2430/2025 (38 provinces, 514 cities and regencies). Map boundaries are simplified for reference and are not a legal delimitation of any territory.
terms_availability_text: The atlas is provided as is, without a promise of uninterrupted or error-free service. Features and data sources may change, pause or end without notice.
terms_liability_text: To the extent permitted by law, the maintainers are not liable for losses that result from using or relying on the atlas or its data.
terms_links_text: Links to data providers and to optional support platforms such as Trakteer, Ko-fi and Patreon lead to services we do not control. Support is voluntary and never affects data, priority or warnings.
terms_changes_text: These terms may be updated. The date above shows the latest revision, and continued use means you accept the current version.
privacy_description: How Atlas Nusantara stores and uses your information.
privacy_storage_text: Your theme, language and pinned regions are kept in your browser's local storage on your device. There is no account, and we do not receive this information.
privacy_notifications_text: Live alerts are not connected yet. Turning notifications off here does not revoke browser permission.
privacy_tracking_text: One Google AdSense placement loads automatically on the homepage. Google receives network and browser information and may use cookies or similar storage. Ad blockers or ad failures do not limit access to the atlas.
privacy_location_text: With your permission, location selects your starting province when you open the map. Outside Indonesia, denied, or unavailable locations fall back to Jakarta. Location stays on your device and is not sent to our servers. The location button can also suggest a nearby region.
earthquake_archive_details: Dated observations from BMKG’s M5+ archive. The dots mark epicentres, not predictions or warnings.
source_not_connected_details: We don’t have a verified dataset to show here. Check the official source for information.
places_description: Keep the places you care about here. Saved only on this device.
forecast_nearby: Forecast for the nearest available location
forecast_archive_note: A saved BMKG forecast, not live conditions.
support_maker: More from the maker at readynaz.com
atlas_intro: Get to know Indonesia, one place at a time. Pick an island or province, then see its places to visit, food, wildlife and weather.
hazard_reports_details: Cleaned and merged from BNPB official records, PetaBencana.id citizen reports and news headlines (ANTARA, GDELT). Diamonds are official, circles citizen reports, triangles news. Pins sit at the reported point or the centre of the named regency. None of this is an official warning, and no record does not mean no event.
hazard_warnings_details: Active BMKG weather warnings (CAP). Each triangle marks the centre of a warned area; the list names the affected places.
hazard_none_warnings: This snapshot contains no active warnings.
mountain_data_note: BIG Atlas 1:250,000 · classification is not a live safety alert. Unclassified does not mean inactive.
mountain_coverage: Named BIG atlas features, not every summit in Indonesia.
destination_click_province: Select a province or a marker to explore its attractions.
destination_coverage_note: Collected source records, not a complete tourism inventory. Unavailable categories and images are marked explicitly.
stat_facts_source: Rounded national figures from BPS, BIG, Badan Bahasa and Indonesian maritime authorities. Official counts are revised over time.
export_unavailable: There is no data to export for this layer yet.
export_note: The file holds the data behind the current layer and view. Check the source terms before reusing it.
region_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the numbers instead.
place_refine: Showing the first {count}. Type more to narrow the list.
observatory_saved_note: Live collection is not available right now, so this shows the saved snapshots from {date}.
population_no_data_note: Grey: no comparable BPS data for this year.
population_pyramid_national_note: BPS publishes age and sex tables for Indonesia as a whole, so this pyramid is national, not {province}.
population_boundary_note: {province} was created or redrawn recently, so BPS values before {year} describe a different area and are not shown.
population_province_hint: Select a province on the map to see its own figures.
og_headline: Find your next favourite in Indonesia.
og_description: Discover Indonesia’s places, local flavours, wildlife and weather on a playful 3D atlas. Pick a place, follow your curiosity, and start exploring.
population_pyramid_region_note: BPS publishes age and sex tables for provinces and regencies/cities for {year} only, so this pyramid does not change with the year picker.
share_destination_caveat: Photo and details come from public catalogues and may be out of date. Check before you travel.
language_heatmap_note: Darker means more local languages recorded in the province. A language spoken in several provinces counts in each.
language_panel_desc: Number of local languages recorded per province by Badan Bahasa (Peta Bahasa).
language_province_hint: Select a province on the map to see its languages.
species_search: Search name, Latin name or family
species_click_province: Select a province or a marker to explore the species recorded there.
species_coverage_note: Lists come from GBIF records and other open sources, so they are incomplete: a species appears where it was recorded, not across its whole range. Status is the IUCN category found in a source; "Not evaluated" means none was found.
species_share_caveat: Photo, status and description come from public biodiversity sources and may be out of date or incomplete.
cuisine_choose_province: Choose a province on the map to explore more dishes.
cuisine_id_fallback: This recipe is available in Indonesian only.
cuisine_machine_notice: Machine translation has not been reviewed.
cuisine_no_recipe_yet: No recipe found for this dish yet.
cuisine_share_caveat: Name, description and photo come from public sources and may be out of date or incomplete.
cuisine_coverage_note: Dishes follow the provincial list on Indonesian Wikipedia, so a province is an association, not proof of origin. Recipes are written by their authors and link to their source. A missing recipe or photo does not mean a dish does not exist.
